name: Ziprasidone
metabolism: Most metabolic clearance is reductive, involving glutathione and aldehyde oxidase, rather than CYP oxidation. CYP3A4 contributes to the smaller oxidative component. Elimination is mainly fecal as metabolites.
summary: Ziprasidone is an atypical antipsychotic used to treat schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It is available orally and as an intramuscular injection for acute agitation associated with schizophrenia.
